client_name.description: The client name (principal) to request tickets for. Default is login username.

encryption_types.description: List of encryption types to use (e.g., aes256, aes128). If empty, defaults are used by the library.

ticket_granter.description: Service name in ticket to use for authenticating request (TGS). Default is krbtgt/REALM@REALM.

start_time.description: Specify when the ticket should start to be valid. Empty for immediate.

end_time.description: Specify when ticket validity should expire. Empty for default (8 hours).

renew_till.description: Specify renewable life of ticket. Implies --renewable. Empty for default (1 week).

ticket_file.description: Path to file to read tickets from.

ticket_write_file.description: Path to file to write tickets to. Empty to write back to source.

server_name.description: The server name (service principal) to request a ticket for. Default is krbtgt/REALM.
